note: Open water from Sentinel-1 VH below -25 dB, bounded by height above nearest drainage. One threshold for the whole river, tuned against Sentinel-2 optical water during a flood rather than against the channel at low flow. water_km2 is all water; flood_km2 excludes the permanent channel.
window: Window ends are grid dates, not acquisition dates: the grid is a sequence of 12-day bins whose phase comes from whenever this series was first built. Each cycle's observation block carries the window start and end, the acquisition dates inside it, the scene count, the relative orbits and the platforms.

skill.note: Both water masks scored against Sentinel-2 optical water on a flood date, inside the area the optical scene can see. Recall is water found, precision is water correctly called, IoU is the two together.

corridor_note: river[] is measured once over the dissolved union of the publishing corridors, not summed from the stretches. The corridors are 20 km buffers that meet at a gauge, so neighbours overlap by 1,328-1,651 km2 each - 9,889 km2 in all, 17.7% of their summed area, every km2 of it channel. union_corridor_km2 is the area of that union; the stretches' own corridor_km2 must not be added together.
stage_correlation_note: How each stretch's water area moves with the stage at the gauge below it, over the published cycles. Context, not validation: extent at a given stage depends on topography, connectivity, vegetation and whether the wave is rising or falling, so a weak correlation is expected. A negative one means the reach is measuring something that is not the river.
